title: A package's own standards
description: data/packages/<id>/standards.yaml: the standards a package brings with it, beside the commons' (data/benchmarks/). Each entry is a benchmark.schema.json entry; tools/validate_entities.py checks them against it. Owned by the package: only it, and a philosophy that borrows from it, may reference them. An id must be new — neither the commons' nor another package's.

categories.description: Groups this package adds to data/benchmarks/categories.yaml, listed after the commons' ones.
